title: Add a network printer using AirPrint or IPP Everywhere
summary: Add a modern network printer that supports AirPrint or IPP Everywhere without needing specific drivers. This uses the 'everywhere' model.
prerequisites: Avahi is installed and running for network discovery.
You know the IP address or hostname of the printer.

steps.explain: Add the printer queue using lpadmin. Replace <PRINTER_NAME> with a short name for the queue and <PRINTER_IP> with the printer's IP address.

placeholders.name: PRINTER_NAME
placeholders.description: A short, descriptive name for the printer queue (no spaces).

placeholders.name: PRINTER_IP
placeholders.description: The IP address of the network printer.

placeholders.name: PRINTER_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the printer queue to remove.

warnings: Ensure the printer supports IPP Everywhere or AirPrint.
Avahi must be running for automatic discovery, though manual IP addition works without it.
